title: Broadstairs Dickens Festival
venue: Venues across Broadstairs (Pierremont Hall, Bandstand, Viking Bay, Victoria Gardens)
price: Most street events free; some shows ticketed
description: Broadstairs has celebrated Charles Dickens, who spent many summers in the town, with a June festival since 1937. For a long weekend the streets fill with people in Victorian costume playing his characters. Recent editions have included a grand costumed parade setting off from Pierremont Hall, a Victorian bathing party on Viking Bay, a Victorian fair at Bleak House and evening shows at the Sarah Thorne Theatre. The organisers' website gives 18-20 June 2027; the detailed timetable is usually released closer to the date.

title: Broadstairs Folk Week
venue: Venues across Broadstairs: stages, church halls, pub gardens and campsite
price: Many free events; week, day and event tickets for the rest
booking: Tickets via the Folk Week website (Ticket Tailor)
description: A long-running folk festival that takes over Broadstairs for a full week every August, with more than 400 events: concerts, ceilidhs and dances, morris sides dancing in the streets, a parade, workshops, poetry, singing sessions in pubs, a craft and music fair and many free events for families. There is a festival campsite. Expected dates: the 2026 week ran Friday 7 to Friday 14 August and 2025 also ran Friday to Friday in the second week of August, so 2027 is estimated at 6-13 August. Week passes for 2027 are already on sale but the organiser has not yet stated the dates.

title: Broadstairs Autumn Food Festival
description: A three-day food and drink festival in the clifftop Victoria Gardens, with around a hundred independent producers, street food, cookery demonstrations and tasting sessions. Entry is free; only the special wine and beer tastings need tickets. Expected dates: the 2026 edition ran Friday 2 to Sunday 4 October (10am-6pm Fri/Sat, 10am-5pm Sun), so 2027 is estimated for the first weekend of October; the organiser has not published it yet.

title: Broadstairs Water Gala
description: A traditional summer day on and around Viking Bay: beach games, water activities and paddleboard taster sessions during the day, live music on the bandstand in the evening and a firework display over the bay to finish. The gala is held on a Wednesday in late July, with the exact day set around the tides. Expected date: 2024 was 24 July, 2026 was Wednesday 29 July, so the last Wednesday of July 2027 (28 July) is the best estimate; not yet announced.

title: Broadstairs Summer Fireworks
description: On selected Wednesday evenings in the summer holidays local bands play on the seafront from about 8pm, followed by fireworks fired over Viking Bay at around 9.45pm. Run by the Broadstairs Firework Events team. Expected: past seasons ran on several Wednesdays in late July and August (for example 27 August 2025); the 2027 nights have not been announced, so check which Wednesdays before going.

title: Broadstairs Family Firework Night
description: Broadstairs marks Bonfire Night with a free family display over Viking Bay. Live music starts in the early evening and the fireworks go up at about 7pm; nearby roads close from around 6pm and extra buses have run in past years. Expected date: held on 5 November in 2025 and listed by the town council for 5 November 2026, so Friday 5 November 2027 is assumed; not yet announced.

title: Broadstairs Christmas Market
description: A one-day Christmas market at Pierremont Hall with stalls, festive food and carol singing in the late afternoon. Expected date: the 2025 market was on Saturday 29 November (11am-5pm, carols at 4.30pm), the same day as several other Thanet switch-ons, so the last Saturday of November 2027 is the estimate; not yet announced.

title: Broadstairs Jazzfest
venue: Pubs and venues around Broadstairs (started at The Magnet micropub)
description: A young jazz festival that began at The Magnet micropub and spreads across several small venues in town over an autumn weekend, with local and visiting jazz musicians. Expected dates: the first edition ran 4-6 October and later editions have stayed in early October, so the first weekend of October 2027 is the estimate. Venue and dates still to be announced by the organisers (Facebook page).

title: Margate Pride
venue: Walpole Bay Lawns to Dreamland and the seafront
description: Thanet's LGBTQIA+ celebration: Pride Day opens with a family programme on the lawns at Walpole Bay, then a colourful march along the seafront to Dreamland, followed by music and performances. The day is free and sits inside a wider Margate Pride festival of art and social events running from the end of July through August. Expected date: Pride Day was Saturday 9 August 2025 and Saturday 8 August 2026 (both the second Saturday of August), so Saturday 14 August 2027 is the estimate; not yet announced.

title: Margate Soul Weekender
venue: The Lido (Sunset Stage) and seafront venues
description: A long-running summer weekend of northern soul, Motown, funk and rare groove, with DJs and live acts at the Lido's Sunset Stage and other seafront bars and cafes in Margate and Cliftonville. 2026 was its 25th year. Expected: festival listing sites already show the 26th edition as Friday 6 to Sunday 8 August 2027 (one says to Monday 9), but no line-up or official confirmation was found. Day and weekend passes; no camping.

title: Margate Carnival
venue: Seafront parade from Palm Bay to Westbrook Bay
description: Margate's carnival has been part of the town's summer for more than a century. The parade of floats, samba bands, dance groups and costumed walkers sets off from Palm Bay in the afternoon and follows the seafront about 2.5 miles past the Main Sands to Westbrook Bay; the stretch between Palm Bay and Nayland Rock gives the best view. A funfair runs at Palm Bay over the weekend. Expected date: it is held on the first Sunday of August (2 August 2026), so 1 August 2027; not yet announced.

title: Margate Meltdown
description: Thousands of motorcyclists and scooter riders ride out from the Ace Cafe in London to Margate seafront on the Spring Bank Holiday Monday, where the road is given over to parked bikes, DJs and live bands. Free to wander round and raises money for a forces charity. Expected date: always on the late-May bank holiday Monday, which in 2027 is 31 May; the seafront has opened about 9am and closed about 5pm. Not yet announced.

title: Margate Summer Series at Dreamland
venue: Dreamland Scenic Stage and Hall by the Sea
description: Each summer Dreamland stages a run of big-name open-air concerts on its Scenic Stage next to the historic roller coaster, plus shows in the Hall by the Sea. The 2026 series ran from mid-June to late August with headliners such as Tom Grennan, Garbage, Kesha, Bastille and Fatboy Slim. Expected: a 2027 series in June-August is likely, but acts and dates are announced one by one, so the dates shown are only the usual season span.

title: Margate Film Festival
description: An independent film festival held over several days in late autumn, with screenings and events in venues around Margate. The 2024 edition ran 27 November to 1 December and the 2026 edition (its 7th) was announced for November. Expected: the 2027 dates are estimated for the last week of November; nothing has been published yet.

title: Christmas in Margate and tree lights switch-on
venue: High Street and Market Place, Margate Old Town
description: A free festive day in Margate town centre with a community stage, a Christmas grotto and market stalls, ending with carols and the Mayor switching on the Christmas tree lights in the late afternoon. Expected date: in 2025 it was Saturday 29 November (11am-4pm, carols 4.30pm, lights 5pm); the last Saturday of November 2027 is the estimate.

title: Sunday music at the Oval Bandstand
description: The bandstand in the Oval gardens on the Cliftonville clifftop hosts live music on Sundays through the summer season, a relaxed free-to-wander outdoor setting above the sea. Expected: the programme runs on Sundays from April to September each year; the 2027 line-up is published on the bandstand's website in spring.

title: Ramsgate Week sailing regatta
venue: Royal Temple Yacht Club and offshore racing area
description: The Royal Temple Yacht Club's International Ramsgate Week brings cruiser and racing yachts from Britain and the Continent for a week of racing off the Kent coast, with courses in the Downs between the North and South Forelands and social events ashore around the Royal Harbour. The club lists Ramsgate Week 2027 as 25-30 July.

title: Ramsgate Festival of Sound
description: A town-wide music and sound festival with many free events: 'Busk Until Dusk' fills the streets with live music, the 'Sonic Trail' links sound installations and art, and pubs, halls and the harbour host gigs, cabaret and club nights. Expected dates: 2026 ran Thursday 10 to Sunday 13 September with a launch party on the Thursday; 2027 is estimated for 9-12 September. Not yet announced.

title: Ramsgate Carnival and Fair
description: Ramsgate's carnival, running for over a century, fills the last weekend of July: a funfair, live entertainment and DJs at Government Acre on both days, a giants parade on the Saturday and the main carnival procession of floats, hooden horses and dance groups setting off from Government Acre on Sunday afternoon (4pm in 2026). Expected: 2026 was 25-26 July; 2027 is estimated as 24-25 July, though 31 July-1 August is possible. Not yet announced.

title: Ramsgate Pirates Festival
description: A swashbuckling family festival around the Royal Harbour and town centre, with pirate costumes, entertainment and a smugglers' theme. The first edition was a single Saturday, 6 June 2026, and was popular enough that the organiser plans a full weekend for 2027. Expected: estimated as the first weekend of June 2027; dates to be announced.

title: Ramsgate Day
description: A one-day themed celebration of the town in mid-August, with performances, workshops and stalls spread through the town centre and harbourside; 2026 had a circus theme. Expected: 2026 was Saturday 15 August; 2027 is estimated for a mid-August Saturday (14 August). Date and theme will be announced nearer the time.

title: Ramsgate Literary Festival
venue: The Book Hotel at The Falstaff, Addington Street
description: A week of author talks, readings, workshops and music centred on The Book Hotel at The Falstaff in Ramsgate. Expected: 2026 ran Saturday 23 to Saturday 30 May; 2027 is estimated for the same late-May week (22-29 May). Dates have not been confirmed.

title: Pugin Week
venue: St Augustine's Church, The Grange and St Edward's Presbytery
description: A week honouring the Victorian architect Augustus Pugin, who lived and built in Ramsgate. Free events open up his church of St Augustine's (where he is buried), his house The Grange and St Edward's Presbytery, with tours and talks. Expected: 2026 ran Monday 7 to Sunday 13 September; 2027 is estimated for 6-12 September, overlapping Heritage Open Days. Not yet announced.

title: St George's Day Spring Parade
venue: Starting at St George's Church, Church Hill
description: A spring community parade around St George's Day that sets off from Ramsgate's landmark St George's Church. Expected: held in April each year; the 2027 date has not been announced, so 24 April (the Saturday after St George's Day) is only an estimate.

title: Ramsgate Through the Senses
description: A spring weekend festival with events in several Ramsgate venues, one of the town's yearly series of themed festivals. Expected: the 2026 edition was the weekend of 25-26 April; 2027 is estimated as 24-25 April. Details and dates to be announced by Visit Ramsgate.

title: Punk & Cider Festival
description: A pub festival over the August Bank Holiday weekend at the Elephant & Castle, with punk bands in the evenings on Friday and Saturday and afternoon garden sessions on Sunday and Monday, plus a big cider selection. Expected: always the August Bank Holiday weekend, which in 2027 is Friday 27 to Monday 30 August.

title: Ramsgate Autumn Festival
description: A multi-venue programme of events across Ramsgate around the October half term and Halloween. Expected: the 2026 festival runs 23 October to 1 November; 2027 is estimated for a similar ten days ending on Halloween. Programme and dates to be announced.

title: Ramsgate Winter Festival and lights switch-on
venue: Town centre and Royal Harbour; parade from St George's Church
description: Ramsgate's winter season opens with the Christmas lights switch-on: a day of stalls and entertainment in the town centre, then a parade from the High Street to St George's Church and the lights coming on at dusk. The Winter Festival then runs into the new year with installations, concerts and events. Expected: the switch-on was Sunday 30 November 2025 and the 2026 festival provisionally starts Sunday 29 November, so Sunday 28 November 2027 is the estimate.

title: Ramsgate Illuminations
venue: Royal Harbour: the Marina, the Arches and the Obelisk
description: Through December the Royal Harbour is lit up, with illuminations along the marina, the Victorian harbour arches and the Obelisk - a good evening stroll with the boats reflected in the water. Expected: 2026 runs 1-31 December; the same month is assumed for 2027.

title: New Year's Eve Lantern Parade
venue: St George's Church to Ramsgate Tunnels via High Street and Harbour Street
description: Part of the Ramsgate Winter Festival: at dusk on New Year's Eve, residents carrying home-made lanterns join the Ramsgate Giants, artists and community groups in a parade from St George's Church down the High Street and Harbour Street to the Ramsgate Tunnels. Free lantern-making workshops run beforehand. Expected: held on 31 December in recent years (about 4.45-5.30pm); 2027 details not yet announced.

title: Ellington Park Christmas Fayre
description: A small community Christmas fair in Ellington Park, the public park on the St Lawrence side of Ramsgate, with festive stalls set out near the park's community cafe - a low-key local alternative to the big town-centre events. Expected: held on a Sunday in mid-December; 12 December 2027 is an estimate, the date is announced nearer the time.

title: Ramsgate Pride
description: Ramsgate's own Pride celebration in September, separate from the bigger Margate Pride in August, with LGBTQIA+ events in venues around the town. Expected: 2026 was set for 19 September; 2027 is estimated for the equivalent Saturday, 18 September. Programme and venues are announced nearer the time.

title: Coastbuster 10 Mile and 10K
description: A seaside road race organised by Coastal Striders, with a 10-mile race, a 10K and a junior run, based at Government Acre on Ramsgate's West Cliff and taking in the harbour and coast. Good to watch from the promenade. Expected: the 2026 race is on Sunday 15 November at 10am; 2027 is estimated for a mid-November Sunday (21 November). Not yet announced.

title: Thanet Coastal 10 and 5 Mile
description: Thanet Roadrunners' end-of-year road race along the Thanet coast with sea views, offering 10-mile and 5-mile distances, a finisher's medal for everyone and music at the finish - a last race before Christmas. Expected: the 2026 race is on Sunday 6 December at 10am from Palm Bay school; 2027 is estimated for Sunday 5 December.

title: Heritage Open Days in Thanet
venue: Venues across Thanet (e.g. Powell-Cotton Museum, Pierremont Hall, The Grange)
description: England's largest heritage festival opens normally closed or paid-for places for free. In Thanet the 2026 programme had 36 free events: history walks, open churches, tours of the Walpole Bay Hotel and Pugin's Grange, Dickens-themed routes in Broadstairs, Westgate high-street stories and archaeology at the Powell-Cotton Museum in Birchington. Expected: 2026 ran 11-20 September; a local listing gives 10-19 September 2027, but the national organiser has not confirmed it. Some events need booking.

title: Kent Tribute Festival
description: A weekend music festival on the Countryside Stage in the grounds of Quex Park, featuring tribute acts to famous bands and artists. It was new in 2026 and Quex Park already lists the 2027 edition for Friday 28 to Sunday 30 May (the late-May bank holiday weekend), from 3pm on Friday to 10pm on Sunday. Line-up and prices on the festival site.

title: Monster Slam
description: A monster-truck show in the grounds of Quex Park, one of the park's big summer family days out alongside its concerts and country show; it came in July 2026 and returns in 2027. Quex Park lists Monster Slam 2027 for Sunday 25 July; show times and tickets are released by the organiser.

title: Salute to the Forces
description: A two-day weekend event at Quex Park listed under the title Salute to the Forces for Saturday 31 July and Sunday 1 August 2027. Quex Park has not yet published a programme, times or prices; the title points to a tribute to the armed forces. Contact the Quex Park events team for details.

title: Kent Country Show
description: A traditional country show in the parkland of Quex Park over the August Bank Holiday weekend, with arena displays, family entertainment, pedigree and fun dog shows. Expected: it ran 24-25 August 2025 (10am-5pm) and is listed for 30-31 August 2026, always the bank holiday Sunday and Monday, so 29-30 August 2027 is the estimate. Not yet announced.

title: Easter trail at Quex Adventure Farm Park
venue: Quex Adventure Farm Park, Quex Park
description: An Easter-holiday trail for young children at Quex Adventure Farm Park, from the team behind the park's Christmas Elf Express; tickets include entry to the farm park and its bouncing pillows. Expected: the 2026 'Bouncing Bunnies' trail ran on selected days in late March and early April around Easter; with Easter on 28 March 2027 the trail is expected over the Easter holidays, roughly 27 March to 11 April. Tickets sell out, book online.

title: Trick or Treat Trail at Quex
venue: Quex Adventure Farm Park, Quex Park
description: A Halloween trail for families at Quex Adventure Farm Park, with a pumpkin for each child and a ride on the 'Slime Blaster Express'. Expected: in 2026 it ran on selected days from mid-October to Halloween (the listings disagree on the exact days); 2027 is expected over the same period, around the October half term.

title: Halloween Fest at Quex (ages 11+)
description: A scarier evening Halloween event at Quex Park aimed at teenagers and adults (age 11 and over), separate from the family trail. Expected: 2026 nights were 24, 25 and 31 October; 2027 is expected on selected evenings in the last week of October. Dates not yet announced.

title: The Elf Express at Quex
venue: Quex Adventure Farm Park, Quex Park
description: A ticketed Christmas experience for families at Quex Adventure Farm Park, run by the same team as the park's Easter trail. Expected: the 2025 season ran 1-24 December; the 2026 and 2027 dates have not been published, so the same December run is assumed. Book online, popular dates sell out.

title: Quex Christmas lights switch-on
venue: Quex Adventure Farm Park, Quex Park
description: Quex Adventure Farm Park held its first Christmas lights switch-on in 2025: an early-evening event with figure skating, carols and the lighting of the tree, free but ticketed. Expected: 2025 was Sunday 30 November (4.30-7pm); if repeated, the end of November 2027 is the estimate.

title: Birchington Christmas and lights switch-on
venue: Dog Acre, The Centre (Alpha Road) and Station Road shops
description: Birchington's village Christmas day: a fair on Dog Acre, stalls and activities in The Centre on Alpha Road, offers in the Station Road shops and entertainment through the day, ending with the Christmas lights switch-on in the early evening (the tree in The Square is lit too). Expected: 2024 was Saturday 23 November and 2025 Saturday 29 November (10am-6pm, switch-on 5.30pm), so late November 2027 is the estimate.

title: Birchington Active Leisure Showcase
venue: Dog Acre and The Centre, Alpha Road
description: A free community day run by the Birchington Active Leisure Forum: dance, choirs, line dancing and music on an outdoor stage on Dog Acre, a dog-training demonstration, and inside The Centre an exhibition by 30-plus local clubs covering sport, arts, music, heritage, gardening and volunteering, with free refreshments. Expected: the third showcase was Saturday 11 July 2026 (10am-2.30pm); 2027 is estimated for 10 July.

title: Great British Beach Clean at Minnis Bay
booking: Register with the Marine Conservation Society
description: Volunteers clear and survey litter along Minnis Bay as part of the Marine Conservation Society's national Great British Beach Clean, whose results feed into UK marine-litter data. Family friendly. Expected: the 2026 clean here was on 19 September; the national event is held in mid to late September, so Saturday 18 September 2027 is an estimate. Register through the MCS site.

title: Westgate-on-Sea Christmas lights switch-on
description: Westgate's Christmas family day on Station Road, run by the town council: stalls, children's rides, two stages of entertainment and Santa's grotto in the station office, with the lights switched on at about 4.30pm (by the local panto cast in 2025). Expected: 1 December 2024 and 30 November 2025, both Sundays, so Sunday 28 November 2027 is the estimate.

title: Heritage Open Days at Reculver Towers
description: English Heritage opens up the twin medieval towers at Reculver, standing in the remains of a Roman shore fort on the cliff edge, for Heritage Open Days, with short history talks. The north tower also opens on selected days between April and September. Expected: 2026 openings were 11-13 and 19-20 September (10am-4pm); 2027 is expected on the Heritage Open Days weekends, estimated 10-19 September.

title: Herne Bay Festival
venue: Venues across Herne Bay seafront and town
description: Several weeks of mostly free summer events in Herne Bay: a folk festival, a jazz festival, cartoon festival, music and fireworks, the Herne Bay Carnival and Pride Day, art workshops, guided walks and talks, foraging, beach scavenging and crab catching. Expected: 2025 ran 20 July-17 August and 2026 24 July-16 August; 2027 is estimated for late July to mid-August. The organisers are inviting 2027 event proposals but have not set dates.

title: Herne Bay Summer FEASTival
description: A free weekend food and craft market by the Victorian clock tower on Herne Bay seafront, with international street food, artisan groceries, crafts and gifts, plus live music. Expected: 2026 ran Friday 14 to Sunday 16 August (roughly 10/11am to 6/7pm); 2027 is estimated for 13-15 August. Not yet announced.

title: Herne Bay Jazz & Swing Festival
description: Jazz and swing bands on Herne Bay Pier as part of the wider Herne Bay Festival, with the jazz weekend falling in mid-August. Expected: in 2025 the festival's jazz weekend was 15-17 August with the pier day on Sunday 17 August; 2027 is estimated for Sunday 15 August. Not yet announced.

title: Whitstable Rocks Oyster Festival
venue: East Quay, the harbour and Long Beach
description: Whitstable's oyster festival celebrates its centuries-old oyster fishery: free live music in the Grading Shed on East Quay, fireworks over the water on Friday, the historic Landing of the Oysters ceremony on the beach, oyster-eating and shucking contests, a mud tug-of-war and candlelit grotters, with free family activities on Long Beach. Expected: 2026 ran Friday 11 to Sunday 13 September; 2027 is estimated for 10-12 September.

title: Canterbury Festival
venue: Canterbury Cathedral and venues across the city
price: Mix of ticketed and free events
description: Canterbury's annual arts festival fills two weeks of the second half of October with well over a hundred events: classical concerts (including in the cathedral), circus, comedy, cabaret, talks, walks and free family activities. Expected: 2026 runs Friday 16 to Saturday 31 October; 2027 is estimated for mid to late October. The programme is usually published in July.

title: Canterbury's Cooking food and drink festival
description: Canterbury's food and drink festival in the Dane John Gardens beside the city walls: a street-food court, open-air dining, two live music stages, children's entertainment and an ale and cider festival. Expected: 2026 is listed for Friday 25 to Sunday 27 September and earlier editions were also late-September weekends; 2027 is estimated for 24-26 September.

title: Kent County Show
description: Kent's big agricultural show (its 96th in 2027) draws tens of thousands of visitors: livestock judging and sheep shearing, show jumping and heavy horses, falconry, pig racing and sheepdog displays, vintage vehicles, a Kent-produce shopping avenue and main-arena displays. About an hour's drive from Birchington. Expected: the organisers say July 2027 with dates to come; event directories list 9-11 July 2027.
